title: THE SECRET BEHIND A KOMODO DRAGON'S SLOW WALK
caption: Komodo dragons are much more than giant lizards. 🦎 #KomodoDragon #Reptiles #Wildlife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Why does a Komodo dragon move with such deliberate steps?
narration_timeline.scene: Real Komodo dragon on the move in Lisbon Zoo; captive context retained.

narration_timeline.text: This enormous monitor lizard lives naturally on a small group of Indonesian islands.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Komodo dragon species in zoo; no claim that this footage is Indonesian wilderness.

narration_timeline.text: Watch the heavy body advance as strong legs and a long tail help it balance.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Komodo dragon walking; no fabricated attack or prey.

narration_timeline.text: Its forked tongue gathers scent particles, giving it clues about nearby animals.
narration_timeline.scene: Real Komodo portrait/movement while narrating sensory biology; no claim a tongue flick is visible.

narration_timeline.text: That calm-looking pace can be deceptive: Komodo dragons are powerful hunters and scavengers.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Komodo species portrait at closer source segment around 29s, showing power through animal size/face rather than fabricated predation. Recheck final frame and same-recording repetition.

narration_timeline.text: So those measured steps belong to a predator constantly exploring its world.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic archival Komodo island close approach in 2008 (Part 2), then separate Disney zoo movement as supporting payoff. Do not imply the two shots are one event or filmed in 2026; visually verify that the face/legs are prominent.
